mainEntity.name: Why does legal duties of the applicant matter at the obligations stage?

acceptedAnswer.text: It matters because immigration matters do not end at approval, because status maintenance, registrations, updates, and later duties can shape what happens next. Before the next step, legal duties of the applicant usually has to be checked for delay, inconsistency, and procedural risk as much as for the legal rule itself.

mainEntity.name: Why does documentation requirements matter at the obligations stage?

acceptedAnswer.text: It matters because Brazil immigration work usually turns on how well the documents support the facts, not only on whether a person believes they qualify. Before the next step, documentation requirements usually has to be checked for delay, inconsistency, and procedural risk as much as for the legal rule itself.
